blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
blocks.zh: 在建立有能力的AI代理商方面,利用性发展发挥着至关重要的作用. 最近的办法通过递归性自我改进(RSI)改进了利用,但其业绩收益往往伴随着较高的执行成本。 我们引入了HarnessPro,一种无标签的方法,用于不断演化的牵引来提高任务性能并同时降低执行成本. 在此情况下,通过LLM生成的测试对候选带进行评估,而无法获得地面真实解决方案或正式测试。 专门人员对执行轨迹进行诊断,根据不同的性能成本优先事项计划更新,并作为候选工具加以实施。 HarnessPro没有返回单一的航道,而是使用正常的加权平方距离选择,为不同的部署预算提供注重成本(升)、平衡(中)和注重绩效(重)的航道。 被选中的牵引器会进入下一个迭代,其中执行反馈指导进一步更新. 我们的实验涵盖Bench 2号终端、SWE-Bench Pro和Program Bench,使用GPT-5.5和Codex,GLM-5.2和Claude Code。 在这些基准中,使用GPT-5.5和Codex,HarnessPro的重型模式平均通过率收益为2.0个百分点,每个任务的平均成本比RHO降低26.1%。 在使用克洛德代码的GLM-5.2时,这种优势也存在. 代码见https://github.com/pzs19/HarnesPro。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
An agent harness is the software infrastructure that manages interactions between a large language model (LLM) and its environment ( Grace et al., 2026 ) .
Recent work on recursive self-improvement (RSI) ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) uses past execution trajectories to diagnose problems and guide harness updates that improve performance on future tasks ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026a ) .
However, these methods often pursue performance gains through more extensive exploration and stronger verification ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026a ) .
These efforts improve performance, but often at the cost of higher token consumption and increased latency.
This trade-off is less appealing in practical deployment, where the execution cost and latency also matter.
We therefore ask: Can recursive harness self-improvement deliver better performance at lower execution cost?
blocks.zh:
一种代理牵引装置是管理大型语言模型(LLM)与其环境之间的相互作用的软件基础设施(Grace等人,2026年).
最近关于递归自我改进(RSI)(Zhang等人,2026年)的工作利用过去的执行轨迹来诊断问题,并指导利用更新,以提高未来任务的业绩(Suzgun等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年;Pan等人,2026年a).
然而,这些方法往往通过更广泛的探索和加强核查来追求性能收益(Lin等人,2026年;Pan等人,2026年a ).
这些努力提高了业绩,但往往以较高的象征性消费和更高的耐久性为代价。
这种权衡在实际部署中不那么具有吸引力,因为执行成本和延迟也同样重要。
因此,我们要求: 递归性利用自我改进能否以较低的执行成本提供更好的业绩?

blocks.en:
Toward this goal, we introduce HarnessPro , a label-free method for recursive harness self-improvement that uses both performance and cost metrics to guide harness updates and candidate selection.
It orchestrates several specialized agents to turn execution feedback into successive harness updates.
A trajectory analyzer examines repeated rollouts to identify failures and avoidable overhead.
Guided by different performance-cost priorities , a planner turns these diagnoses into harness improvement plans, which an editor implements as executable harness candidates.
A test-synthesis agent provides fixed tests for evaluating the candidates without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests.
Candidates that underperform the initial harness or are Pareto-dominated are discarded.
To accommodate different budgets, we then use normalized weighted squared-distance selection ( Marler and Arora, 2004 ) to retain representative harnesses for cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) modes.
The selected harnesses then enter the next epoch, where further updates pursue different performance-cost priorities.
blocks.zh:
为了实现这一目标,我们引入了HarnessPro,一种无标签的循环利用自我改进方法,使用性能和成本衡量标准来指导利用最新情况和候选人选择。
它召集几个专业特工将执行反馈转化为连续的调用更新.
轨迹分析器检查反复推出,以查明失败和可避免的间接费用。
以不同的业绩成本优先事项为指导,一个规划者将这些诊断转化为利用改进计划,一个编辑作为可执行的利用候选人加以执行。
测试合成剂提供固定测试,用于评价没有获得地面真实解决方案或正式测试的候选人。
最初使用能力不足或以Pareto为主的候选人被抛弃。
为了适应不同的预算,我们然后使用正常的加权方程选择(Marler和Arora,2004年),保留以成本为重(lite)、平衡(中等)和注重业绩(重)模式为重的代表性工具。
所选的带子然后进入下一个时代,在那里进一步更新将追求不同的性能成本优先.

blocks.en:
We evaluate HarnessPro on Terminal-Bench 2 ( The Terminal-Bench Team, 2025 ) , SWE-Bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , and ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code.
With both backbone models, HarnessPro improves task performance while reducing execution cost .
For example, on Terminal-Bench 2 with GPT-5.5 and Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro outperforms RHO ( Pan et al., 2026a ) in pass rate by 4.5 percentage points while reducing mean cost per task by 33.9%.
For more cost-sensitive deployments, the medium mode delivers performance comparable to RHO at substantially lower execution cost.

我们用GPT-5.5与Codex,GLM-5.2与Claude Code。
使用两种主干模型,HarnessPro可以提高任务性能,同时降低执行成本.
例如,在带有GPT-5.5和Codex的Bench 2号终端上,HarnessPro的重型模式在通过率上比RHO(Pan等人,2026a)高出4.5个百分点,同时将每个任务的平均成本降低33.9%。
对于更注重成本的部署,中度模式的交付性能与RHO相当,执行成本大幅降低.

blocks.en:
An analysis of the evolved harnesses shows that HarnessPro does not improve agents simply by compressing context or increasing reasoning effort.
The evolved harnesses dynamically allocate reasoning effort and tool budgets based on task descriptions, while runtime hooks steer execution from exploration toward convergence based on the assigned budgets.
They also adopt tool-output compression like RTK ( Szymkowiak, 2026 ) and streamline instructions to reduce redundant prompt content, while retaining necessary context and final verification.
Together, these mechanisms curb avoidable overhead while preserving the reasoning and verification needed for task success, thereby advancing the performance-cost Pareto frontier.
blocks.zh:
对进化的牵引力的分析表明,HarnessPro不能仅仅通过压缩上下文或增加推理努力来改进代理.
演进的利用了根据任务说明动态分配推理努力和工具预算,同时运行时间钩引导执行从探索转向根据分配的预算趋同。
他们还采用了像RTK(Szymkowiak, 2026年)这样的工具输出压缩,并精简指令以减少冗余的即时内容,同时保留必要的上下文和最终验证.
这些机制共同遏制了可避免的间接费用,同时保持了任务成功所需的推理和核查,从而推进了绩效成本的帕雷托前沿。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We introduce HarnessPro , a multi-agent framework that simultaneously optimizes performance and cost by analyzing execution trajectories and recursively improving harnesses. • We assess candidate artifacts with fixed LLM-generated tests rather than direct LLM judgments, improving failure detection without access to official tests. • Across three benchmarks, HarnessPro improves performance while reducing cost and latency, yielding a series of harnesses with different performance-cost trade-offs.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Agent optimization has expanded from prompts and pre-defined workflows to the executable harness surrounding a model. AFlow searches graphs of model-invoking operators using execution feedback ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . More recent systems directly modify harness components: agentic harness engineering makes edits traceable ( Lin et al., 2026 ) , HarnessFix diagnoses failures before applying repairs ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , and HarnessX composes harnesses from typed primitives using trajectory evidence ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . RHO uses LLMs to evaluate and compare execution trajectories without ground-truth labels, guiding harness evolution toward higher task success ( Pan et al., 2026a ) . In contrast, our method, HarnessPro , optimizes both task success rate and monetary cost. Rather than returning a single harness, it produces a set of harnesses with different performance-cost trade-offs, organized into lite, medium, and heavy tiers.
blocks.zh: 代理优化已经从提示和预定义的工作流程扩展为围绕一个模型的可执行的牵引. AFlow搜索图 使用执行反馈的模型引用运算符(张等,2025). 更近代的系统直接修改了绑带组件:代理绑带工程使得编辑可以追踪(Lin等人,2026年),Harness 修复在进行修复前诊断故障(Chen等人,2026a)和Harness X编曲利用轨迹证据从原始类型中提取(Chen等人,2026b.). RHO使用LLMs在没有地面真实标签的情况下评价和比较执行轨迹,引导驾驭进化到更高的任务成功(Pan等人,2026a). 相比之下,我们的方法,HarnessPro, 优化了任务成功率和货币成本。 它不是返回单一的绳索,而是生产一套具有不同性能成本权衡的绳索,分为升、中和重层。

blocks.en: Some methods focus on specific components, such as skills or memory ( Pan et al., 2026b ) . SkillOpt optimizes skill documents ( Yang et al., 2026b ) , while SkillMOO and FRAMES incorporate cost or regression constraints into skill evolution ( Gong et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Dynamic Cheatsheet and ReasoningBank retain reusable strategies from past experience ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) , while Sleep-time Compute builds reusable memory by reasoning over context before a query arrives ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . MemoryCPT jointly optimizes memory construction, retrieval, and summarization ( Lei et al., 2026 ) . Other work addresses budget allocation at inference time: BATS learns a budget-aware policy for allocating model tokens and external tool calls ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , while COMPAS jointly selects models, prompts, and decoding settings according to task difficulty ( Gong et al., 2026b ) . HarnessPro instead uses past trajectories to evolve the entire harness, including instructions, skills, tools, hooks, and verification rules. Advancing the Pareto frontier thus requires analyzing execution trajectories alongside task outcomes and token usage to distinguish necessary computation from avoidable overhead and find the “sweet spot” that reduces cost without compromising performance.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce HarnessPro , a multi-agent framework that analyzes execution trajectories and iteratively modifies harnesses to advance the performance-cost Pareto frontier. We first outline the evolution process, then describe trajectory-based diagnosis and candidate generation, followed by test-based evaluation and selection.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了HarnessPro,这是一个分析执行轨迹的多代理框架,并反复修改各种手段,以推进性能成本的Pareto前沿。 我们首先概述进化过程,然后描述基于轨迹的诊断和候选人生成,然后是基于测试的评估和选择.

blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: To keep trajectory collection and analysis manageable, we begin by selecting a training coreset 𝒟 train \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{train}} . Following RHO ( Pan et al., 2026a ) , we use the Determinantal Point Process (DPP) kernel ( Kulesza and Taskar, 2012 ) to balance task difficulty and diversity (Appendix A.1 ). Starting from an executable harness h 0 h_{0} , we maintain a candidate set 𝒜 t \mathcal{A}_{t} of harnesses at epoch t t , initialized as 𝒜 0 = { h 0 } \mathcal{A}_{0}=\{h_{0}\} . In each epoch, HarnessPro employs a multi-agent framework to analyze trajectories of these candidate harnesses on the coreset 𝒟 train \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{train}} to identify task failures, unproductive exploration, and redundant computation. The framework then plans and implements harness modifications to address these issues, producing new executable candidate harnesses as described in Section 4.2 .

blocks.en: We evolve harnesses in a label-free setting, without access to ground-truth solutions, official test cases, or graders. Instead of using an LLM to assess and compare trajectories directly, as in RHO ( Pan et al., 2026a ) , we use it to generate tests from task descriptions and trajectories produced by the initial harness. In each epoch, we evaluate candidate harnesses on the validation set using the generated tests, measuring pass rate and execution cost . After discarding candidates that fall below the performance floor or are Pareto-dominated, we use normalized weighted squared-distance selection to retain representatives for cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) modes. The selected harnesses form the candidate set for the next epoch. This process repeats until the epoch limit is reached, after which we fix the harnesses and evaluate them on the test set. Algorithm 1 summarizes the full procedure.
blocks.zh: 我们在无标签的设定中演化,没有获得地面真实解决方案,官方测试案例或分级器. 我们没有像在RHO(Pan et al., 2026a)中那样使用LLM来直接评估和比较轨迹,而是用它来从任务描述和初始牵引产生的轨迹产生测试. 在每一个时代,我们利用生成的测试、通过率和执行成本来评估候选人对验证的利用情况。 在丢弃低于业绩底数或以帕雷托为主的候选人后,我们使用正常的加权平方距离选择,以保留以成本为重点的(升)、平衡的(中)和以业绩为重点的(重)模式的代表。 所选的带子构成下一个时代的候选设置. 这个过程重复到达到时代极限为止,之后我们固定了吊带并在测试集上加以评价. 算法1总结了整个程序.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup

blocks.en:
We evaluate HarnessPro on Terminal-Bench 2 ( The Terminal-Bench Team, 2025 ) , SWE-Bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , and ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , covering terminal tasks, repository-level issue resolution, and program reconstruction.
Following the dataset splitting protocol of RHO ( Pan et al., 2026a ) , we hold out 59, 100, and 100 tasks, respectively, for testing.
From the remaining tasks in each benchmark, we select a 10-task training set 𝒟 train \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{train}} using the DPP-based coreset selection method ( Kulesza and Taskar, 2012 ) described in Section 4.1 .
The remaining tasks form the validation set.
We pair GPT-5.5 with Codex 0.147.0 and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code 2.1.231 .
Each candidate harness produces G = 3 G=3 rollouts per training task in each epoch.
Evolution runs for three epochs on Terminal-Bench 2 and SWE-Bench Pro, and four on ProgramBench, retaining up to three harnesses after each epoch.
All methods use the same data splits and grading settings. Further implementation details are in Appendix A .

blocks.en:
We compare HarnessPro against several strong harness optimization methods.
The original Codex or Claude Code harness is Vanilla , the starting point for optimization. Dynamic Cheatsheet ( Suzgun et al., 2026 ) maintains reusable strategies and code snippets, ReasoningBank ( Ouyang et al., 2026 ) retrieves strategies distilled from past trajectories, and Sleep-time Compute ( Lin et al., 2025 ) prepares reusable memory before new tasks. RHO ( Pan et al., 2026a ) revises harness components through trajectory analysis and selects candidates using LLM self-preference.
To separate the effects of cost-aware and recursive optimization, we include two RHO variants. Balance changes only RHO’s optimization instruction, asking for better task performance at lower cost. RHO+Iteration runs Balance for the same number of epochs as HarnessPro .
Each subsequent epoch starts from the harness selected in the preceding epoch by the best-of- N N procedure of RHO.

blocks.en:
Table 2 compares HarnessPro with several baseline methods across three benchmarks.
With GPT-5.5 and Codex, RHO improves performance over Vanilla on all three benchmarks, but also increases execution cost.
On SWE-Bench Pro, for example, its mean cost per task rises by 42.6%, from $1.88 to $2.68.
In contrast, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves the highest pass rate across all three benchmarks at lower cost than RHO .
On Terminal-Bench 2, the heavy mode of HarnessPro reaches a mean pass rate of 80.8% across three runs, 4.5 percentage points above RHO, with 33.9% lower mean cost.
The advantage extends to ProgramBench, where its 69.6% pass rate exceeds RHO’s 68.8% at 17.8% lower mean cost ($2.95 vs. $3.59).
These results show that better task performance need not come at a higher execution cost.
For the medium mode, we retain strong task performance while reducing cost further.
On SWE-Bench Pro, it achieves a 79.0% pass rate compared with RHO’s 80.0%, while reducing the average cost per task by 53.0%, from $2.68 to $1.26.
The lite mode lowers cost further, outperforming Vanilla on all three benchmarks while spending 17.7–57.4% less , making it an economical choice for deployment under strict budget constraints.
Even with comparable iteration budgets, HarnessPro achieves a better performance–cost trade-off than RHO+Iteration . Our medium mode matches the performance of RHO+Iteration on Terminal-Bench 2 at 31.7% lower cost. Moreover, on ProgramBench, our heavy mode raises pass rate by 1.3 percentage points while lowering mean cost by 5.8%.

通过GPT-5.5和Codex,RHO在所有三个基准上都比Vanilla提高了性能,但也增加了执行成本.
例如,在SWE-Bench Pro上,其每任务的平均成本上升42.6%,从1.88美元上升到2.68美元。
相比之下,HarnessPro的重模式以低于RHO的成本在所有三个基准中实现了最高的通过率.
在Terminal-Bench 2上,HarnessPro的重型模式在3次运行中达到80.8%的平均通过率,比RHO高出4.5个百分点,平均成本降低33.9%.
这一优势扩展到了方案本奇,其69.6%的通过率超过RHO的68.8%,比平均成本低17.8%(2.95美元对3.59美元)。
这些结果表明,更好的任务执行不需要以更高的执行成本。
就中度模式而言,我们保留了强有力的任务业绩,同时进一步降低成本。
在SWE-Bench Pro上,与RHO的80.0%相比,它实现了79.0%的通过率,同时将每个任务的平均成本降低了53.0%,从2.68美元降至1.26美元.
液态模式进一步降低了成本,在所有三个基准上都比香草要好,而支出却少了17.7-57.4%,这使得在严格的预算限制下进行部署是一种经济选择。
即使有可比的迭代预算,HarnessPro也比RHO+迭代实现更好的性能-成本权衡. 我们的中程模式与RHO+Itheration在Bench 2号航站楼的性能相匹配,成本降低31.7%. 此外,在Bench方案上,我们的重型模式将通过率提高了1.3个百分点,同时将平均成本降低了5.8%。

blocks.en:
The results with GLM-5.2 and Claude Code follow a similar pattern: the heavy mode of HarnessPro surpasses RHO on all three benchmarks at lower cost, while the medium and lite modes outperform Vanilla in pass rate, often at substantially lower cost .
Moreover, although latency is not an objective, cost optimization yields faster task completion in most cases.
For example, on SWE-Bench Pro, our heavy mode reduces mean latency from RHO’s 520 to 412 seconds.
blocks.zh:
GLM-5.2和Claude Code的结果也遵循了类似的模式:HarnessPro的重型模式以较低的成本超越了所有三个基准的RHO,而介质模式和lite模式的通过率往往大大低于Vanilla。
此外,虽然暂时性不是目标,但在大多数情况下,成本优化能够更快地完成任务。
例如,在SWE-Bench Pro上,我们的重型模式将平均延迟从RHO的520秒降低到412秒.

blocks.en: 5.3 Analysis of Evolved Harnesses
blocks.zh: 5.3 演化分析

blocks.en:
To understand how HarnessPro improves the performance-cost trade-off, we inspect its evolved harnesses.
On Terminal-Bench 2 and SWE-Bench Pro, they select an execution profile from each task description.
Each profile specifies a reasoning effort level and a tool-call budget.
The lite, medium, and heavy modes use different rubrics for profile selection.
Runtime hooks enforce the selected budget.
For example, on Terminal-Bench 2, when HarnessPro -Medium selects the standard profile, the hooks remind the agent to produce parallel tool calls and avoid redundant checks after 14 tool calls, focus on completing and verifying the task after 26, and block further calls after 44.
The reminders are appended to tool results, preserving the prompt prefix for cache reuse.
Alongside these dynamic mechanisms, the evolved harnesses also reduce static context redundancy .
On Terminal-Bench 2, for instance, tool-output compression like RTK ( Szymkowiak, 2026 ) folds repeated logs and condenses long outputs, while streamlined developer instructions reduce redundant input.
This combination curbs recurring prompt overhead and limits the context growth caused by verbose tool feedback, thereby reducing execution cost and latency.
Implementation details of these harnesses are in Appendix D.1 .

blocks.en: 5.4 Evolution Dynamics

blocks.en:
Figure 4 tracks test-set performance and cost across epochs.
Across all three benchmarks, HarnessPro advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier through recursive harness self-improvement.
On Terminal-Bench 2, each round of evolution improves the retained Pareto frontier , yielding higher pass rates at lower costs.
For example, the pass rate of the heavy mode rises from 74.6% in epoch 1 to a mean of 80.8% in epoch 3, while mean cost per task falls from $0.91 to $0.72 .
The lite and medium modes also maintain their pass rates from epoch 2 to 3, while their mean costs fall from $0.61 to $0.43 and from $0.68 to $0.56, respectively.
The benefits of additional evolution epochs are particularly clear on SWE-Bench Pro, where a single run may raise pass rate at the expense of higher cost .
In the medium mode, pass rate rises from 70.0% in epoch 1 to 77.0% in epoch 2, but mean cost also rises from $1.57 to $1.66.
Only in epoch 3 does it improve both metrics, with pass rate rising to 79.0% and mean cost falling to $1.26 per task.
On ProgramBench, the fourth epoch likewise lowers costs across all three modes while maintaining similar pass rates.
These patterns highlight an advantage of recursive self-improvement over single-round evolution.

blocks.en:
Table 3 examines the contributions of main components of HarnessPro .
We also report Cost-of-Pass (CoP) ( Erol et al., 2026 ) , the total execution cost divided by the number of successful tasks.
Removing the planner reduces performance and increases cost in most experiments.
For example, on SWE-Bench Pro, the pass rate of the medium mode drops from 79.0% to 73.0%, while mean cost rises from $1.26 to $1.42 per task.
Removing the test synthesizer has a larger impact , with pass rates dropping by 3.4–10.0 percentage points across both benchmarks and all three modes.
These performance drops highlight the value of our multi-agent framework.
Beyond these component ablations, we also examine whether RHO can achieve similar gains by simply adopting individual strategies from our evolved harnesses.
As shown in Table 3 , adding either dynamic routing or budget hooks to RHO reduces cost, but can also degrade task performance.
On SWE-Bench Pro, both variants reduce cost but achieve lower pass rates than RHO’s 80.0%.
Uniformly using low reasoning effort yields larger cost savings but also substantially degrades performance.
Overall, all three RHO variants are Pareto-dominated by harnesses evolved by HarnessPro , which achieve higher pass rates at lower cost.

除了这些内容外,我们还审查RHO是否能够通过从我们进化的优势中采取个别战略来取得类似的收益。
如表3所示,在 RHO 中添加动态路由或预算钩可以降低成本,但也能够降低任务性能.
在SWE-Bench Pro上,两种变体都降低了成本,但通过率却低于RHO的80.0%.
统一使用低推理方法可以节省更多的费用,但也大大降低了业绩。
总体而言,所有三种RHO变体都是由哈内斯普罗(HarnessPro)所演化的拉带所支配的,它们以较低的成本实现了更高的通过率.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced HarnessPro , a label-free approach to recursive harness self-improvement that improves task performance while reducing execution cost.
To this end, it coordinates trajectory diagnosis and harness modification through a multi-agent framework, with a dedicated planner proposing update plans and LLM-generated tests guiding candidate evaluation.
Rather than producing a single harness, HarnessPro offers cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) alternatives to meet different deployment budgets.
Experiments across three benchmarks show that HarnessPro can improve task performance while reducing execution cost , with additional benefits in latency .
Further analysis attributes these gains to the synergy of multiple evolved mechanisms and shows sustained progress through recursive self-improvement.
These findings show that performance and efficiency can improve together, making cost-aware evolution a promising direction for practical recursive self-improvement in harness optimization.

我们引入了HarnessPro, 一种无标签的方法,
为此,它通过一个多代理框架,协调轨迹诊断和利用修改,由专门规划员提出更新计划,由LLM产生的测试指导候选人评价.
" HarnessPro " 公司不是生产单一的装备,而是提供注重成本的(lite)、平衡的(中等)和注重绩效的(重型)替代办法,以满足不同的部署预算。
跨越三个基准的实验表明, Pro可以改善任务业绩,同时降低执行成本,并带来额外的好处。
进一步的分析将这些成果归因于多种演化机制的协同作用,并表明通过递归自我改进而持续取得进展。
这些调查结果表明,业绩和效率可以一起提高,使认识到成本的演化成为在优化利用方面切实自我改进的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: ⬇ Prioritize reducing average execution cost while preserving task correctness and reliable completion . Seek genuine efficiency gains , not lower bills obtained by skipping required work , abandoning difficult tasks , or weakening validation . Use the diagnostics , trajectories , and candidate implementations to distinguish necessary work from avoidable expense . Look for recurring sources of redundant exploration , repeated context , or low - value verification . Consider the total cost of execution , including unsuccessful attempts and any overhead introduced by the proposed change ; fewer steps or shorter outputs alone do not establish an improvement . Possible directions include adapting reasoning effort to individual public tasks , managing context and tool feedback economically , and improving convergence or recovery . Preserve the information and checks needed for dependable results . These are optional search directions , not a checklist : derive any mechanism from the available evidence , without assuming a routing rubric , fixed thresholds , profile taxonomy , or per - task rules . Propose a focused , generalizable plan rather than accumulating optimizations . Explain which observed expense each change addresses , why correctness should be preserved , and what regression risks remain . Distinguish expected savings from measured results ; the fixed external evaluator , not the plan ’ s claims , determines whether quality is maintained and cost is reduced .
blocks.zh: 优先减少平均执行费用,同时保持任务正确和可靠完成。 而不是通过跳过所需工作、放弃困难的任务或削弱验证来降低账单。 利用诊断、轨迹和候选实施来区分必要的工作和可避免的费用。 寻找重复的冗余勘探来源、重复上下文或低价值核查。 考虑执行总费用,包括不成功的尝试和拟议变动引起的任何间接费用;仅靠减少步骤或缩短产出并不能带来改进。 可能的方向包括调整推理工作以适应个别公共任务,从经济上管理背景和工具反馈,改善趋同或恢复。 保存可靠结果所需的信息和检查。 这些是可选的搜索方向,而不是核对表 : 从现有证据中获取任何机制,而不假定路由符号、固定阈值、剖面分类或任务规则。 提出一个重点突出、可概括的计划,而不是积累优化。 解释每项变化涉及哪些可观察到的开支、为何应保持正确性以及还存在哪些回归风险。 将预期的节余与衡量的结果区分开来;固定的外部评价员,而不是计划的索赔,决定是否保持质量和降低成本。

blocks.en: ⬇ Seek a balanced improvement in task reliability and average execution cost . Treat correctness and efficiency as joint objectives : do not pursue savings by neglecting required behavior , or assume that additional computation necessarily improves quality . A balanced plan should improve the trade - off , not simply average the other directions . Use the diagnostics , trajectories , and candidate implementations to identify where effort contributes to successful completion and where it is redundant . Compare peer candidates to understand their strengths , weaknesses , and interactions , rather than copying their mechanisms wholesale . Prefer changes that remove low - value work while preserving or strengthening the reasoning and validation that matter . Possible directions include task - adaptive reasoning effort , concise but recoverable context , effective use of tool feedback , and verification or recovery guided by observed uncertainty . These are optional hypotheses , not prescribed designs . Infer an appropriate approach from the evidence ; no routing rubric , fixed thresholds , profile names , or per - task rules are supplied . Account for the overhead and complexity of combining changes . Propose a coherent , generalizable plan and explain its expected quality and cost effects together . Make uncertain trade - offs and regression risks explicit , including why any added work is worthwhile . Keep predicted benefits separate from established findings and let the fixed external evaluator determine whether the joint improvement is real .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 力求平衡地改进任务可靠性和平均执行费用。 将正确性和效率视为共同的目标:不通过忽视必要的行为来追求节约,或假设额外的计算必然提高质量。 一个平衡的计划应该改善贸易,而不是简单地平均其他方向。 利用诊断、轨迹和候选实施,确定哪些工作有助于顺利完成,哪些工作是多余的。 比较同行候选人了解他们的长处、弱点和互动,而不是批量复制他们的机制。 倾向于在保留或加强重要推理和验证的同时,进行删除低值工作的修改。 可能的方向包括任务----适应性推理努力、简洁但可收回的背景、有效利用工具反馈,以及以观察到的不确定性为指导进行核查或恢复。 这些是可选假设,而不是规定的设计。 从证据中推断出一种适当的方法;没有提供路由符号、固定阈值、剖面图名称或按任务规则提供。 考虑合并变化的间接费用和复杂性。 建议一项连贯、笼统的计划,并解释其预期质量和成本效应。 明确不确定的贸易----取消和回归风险,包括为什么任何额外工作都是值得的。 将预期效益与既定结果分开,并让固定外部评价人员确定联合改进是否真实。

blocks.en: ⬇ Prioritize improving task success while continuing to eliminate avoidable expense . Focus on reliable completion and correct behavior , not more elaborate execution for its own sake . Performance - focused evolution should invest effort where it can address meaningful failures , rather than increase computation uniformly across tasks . Use the diagnostics , trajectories , and candidate implementations to identify consequential failure patterns and the limitations behind them . Examine both successful and unsuccessful executions to distinguish useful reasoning or validation from activity that merely adds cost . Draw on peer candidates when their behavior provides relevant evidence , but do not assume that a more complex harness is a more capable one . Possible directions include adapting reasoning effort to the public task , selective deeper investigation or independent verification , and stronger context or recovery management . These are optional hypotheses , not an implementation recipe . Derive the actual design from evidence ; no routing rubric , fixed thresholds , mandatory review schedule , or per - task rules are supplied . Preserve efficient behavior where additional work has no demonstrated purpose . Propose a focused , generalizable plan that explains which failures it aims to prevent and why the changes should help . If additional work is necessary , state the expected quality benefit , cost implications , and remaining risks without presenting predictions as measured gains . The fixed external evaluator determines whether the improvement justifies the resulting quality - cost trade - off .

blocks.en: ⬇ Task : Configure a mailing list with join , leave , and post delivery . Outcome : All three rollouts passed the generated tests . Issue 1: Exploration went well beyond the relevant configuration . Problem : All runs dumped large Mailman / Postfix configs and package source / tests after the task and eval narrowed the relevant surface to mailman . cfg , Postfix local delivery , and Mailman LMTP maps . Quality impact : Some inspection helped , but the broader search added little evidence for final correctness . Cost impact : Trace totals reached 1,058,946, 1,763,487, and 2,517,861 input tokens in runs 0, 1, and 2, respectively ; broad dumps and repeated exploration were major contributors . Evidence : run -0- trace -0. jsonl :36-69,86-93,180; run -1- trace -0. jsonl :22-27,175; run -2- trace -0. jsonl :18-19,180. Issue 2: Final evaluations repeated already covered behavior . Problem : Manual join / post / leave smoke tests usefully checked delivery and leave confirmation , but / app / eval . py was rerun after these and earlier evaluations had passed . Quality impact : Extra evals added little end - to - end coverage . Cost impact : Each eval created Unix users , exercised mail queues , and included retry sleeps . Evidence : run -0- trace -0. jsonl :149-153; run -1- trace -0. jsonl :158-173; run -2- trace -0. jsonl :102-122,167-170. Issue 3: Run 2’ s smoke test temporarily broke mail delivery . Problem : Opening / var / mail /< user > with mailbox . mbox () before Postfix created it produced a root - owned mailbox , so confirmation mail bounced . Quality impact : The agent diagnosed this test - induced failure and reran the smoke test successfully ; the final outcome was unaffected . Cost impact : Log / queue inspection , qfile decoding , reconnects , and another full smoke test followed . Evidence : run -2- trace -0. jsonl :123-152. Issue 4: A service - control pipeline hung in run 1. Problem : A daemonized Mailman start inherited a pipe to sed , leaving the wrapper running after the services started . Quality impact : Services ran , so the final result was unaffected . Cost impact : The agent polled , inspected logs and processes , then terminated the wrapper before evaluation . Evidence : run -1- trace -0. jsonl :104-126. Issue 5: A broad recipient - validation workaround carried a risk . Problem : Run 1 disabled SMTP - time local recipient validation after lookup failures ; run 2 also ended with local_recipient_maps empty . Quality impact : Delivery passed for valid Unix users . Invalid local recipients might be accepted at SMTP time and fail later , a risk not observed in the tests . Cost impact : Two failed evals and map debugging preceded the fallback . Evidence : run -1- trace -0. jsonl :130-159; run -2- trace -0. jsonl :99-100,172-173.

blocks.en: The following Terminal-Bench 2 plans illustrate three performance-cost priorities. The medium and heavy plans start from the same initial harness and trajectory diagnoses. blocks.en: ⬇ objective : Improve the empty baseline harness by adding general solver guidance and lightweight execution support that preserves task - relevant verification while cutting repeated broad exploration , noisy command output , and overconfident local - success conclusions . changes : README . md : Add concise solver guidance : start from the public task contract and required artifacts ; (* @ \ textcolor { artifactExcerpt }{\ ttfamily … ( content is excerpted to save space ) …} @ *) runtime . json : Add a small runtime configuration referencing router_prompt . txt and setting tool_output_token_limit to a moderate value such as 12000, without adding a review session or replacing the model instructions . router_prompt . txt : Add a general cost - aware routing prompt that chooses the lowest reasoning_effort likely to complete the public task : low for bounded recovery or simple one - artifact tasks , medium for routine code / configuration with clear tests , high for multi - file implementations , builds , interpreters , protocol / integration work , numerical algorithms , or weak local oracles , and xhigh only for unusually open - ended tasks where failure would likely come from deep reasoning rather than environment setup . blocks.en: ⬇ objective : Add a small , general harness that steers solvers toward public - contract verification , bounded exploration , and cheaper command output while preserving flexibility for varied tasks . (* @ \ textcolor { artifactExcerpt }{\ ttfamily … ( content is excerpted to save space ) …} @ *) changes : README . md : Create concise solver guidance : derive an acceptance checklist from the public task first ; use only public task files and legitimate upstream documentation , never benchmark answers / graders / solutions ; inspect files in narrow slices ; check tool availability once ; prefer Python fallback inspection in minimal containers ; avoid dumping large logs , matrices , generated files , or whole source files ; complete all running commands before final ; verify required artifacts with semantic / end - to - end checks rather than only syntax , existence , or nonblank outputs . runtime . json : Create with a conservative tool_output_token_limit , for example 16000, to cap accidental giant outputs from package managers , build logs , tracebacks , git usage text , and file dumps while still leaving room for meaningful compiler or test failures . tools / run_logged . py : Add an executable Python helper with a shebang that runs a command with an optional timeout , writes the full stdout / stderr stream to a log file , and prints only command , exit code , elapsed time , and the final bounded tail . README should recommend it for apt / build / train / long - test commands so expensive workflows can preserve diagnostics without flooding context . tools / probe . py : Add an executable Python helper with a shebang for common low - dependency inspections : command - exists checks , limited head / tail display , hex / ascii byte previews , JSON validation , CSV column / row summaries , file size / hash , and simple BMP / PNG metadata where possible . This replaces repeated assumptions about unavailable utilities such as file , sqlite3 , xxd , strings , and git . quality_impact : Expected to improve reliability by making solvers explicitly map public requirements to final artifacts , require semantic verification before success claims , and avoid continuing from misleading checks such as command - not - found text hidden inside successful pipelines . (* @ \ textcolor { artifactExcerpt }{\ ttfamily … ( content is excerpted to save space ) …} @ *) cost_impact : Expected to reduce avoidable token and latency costs from repeated broad file reads , package / build log dumps , missing - tool probes , noisy git failures , and redundant post - success inspection . (* @ \ textcolor { artifactExcerpt }{\ ttfamily … ( content is excerpted to save space ) …} @ *) There is no added second solver session or uniform extra reasoning pass . risks : Guidance - only changes depend on solver compliance , and an output cap can hide useful detail if commands are not logged through the helper . The helper scripts must remain dependency - free and generic . More rigorous semantic verification can add some task - local execution cost , so the README should emphasize checks tied to public requirements rather than broad extra exploration .

blocks.en: ⬇ objective : Reduce solver and exploratory cost by correcting a router that was observed to choose high or xhigh for most sampled tasks , while retaining task - specific reasoning - effort selection and public - contract correctness . changes : runtime . json : Keep router_prompt connected so each task still receives a dynamically selected reasoning_effort . (* @ \ textcolor { artifactExcerpt }{\ ttfamily … ( content is excerpted to save space ) …} @ *) Reduce tool_output_token_limit from 12000 to about 8000 to limit recurring transcript growth without removing useful diagnostics . router_prompt . txt : Rewrite the rubric to counter the observed high / xhigh bias : make medium the preferred starting point for bounded tasks with a plausible implementation path and practical checks , even when they mention several files , a build , data processing , or an unfamiliar domain . blocks.en: ⬇ You are Codex , a non - interactive software agent . Work autonomously until the user ’ s task is complete . Follow the task ’ s integrity , safety , path , and output requirements exactly . Use the available tools to inspect , edit , execute , and verify ; batch independent checks and avoid repeating unchanged reads . Preserve unrelated files and avoid destructive operations outside the requested scope . Do not replace a requested implementation or service with a mock , proxy , or look - alike unless the task explicitly permits that substitution . Do not spawn other agents or ask the user to perform routine steps . Keep progress messages brief . Before finishing , leave every requested artifact at its exact path and run the strongest allowed task - shaped verification . Report the outcome concisely , including any genuine remaining uncertainty .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 你是Codex, 一个非交互式软件代理。 自动工作直到用户任务完成为止。 遵循任务的完整性、安全性、路径和产出要求。 使用现有工具检查、编辑、执行和核实;批次独立检查并避免重复,原文不变。 保存不相关的文件,避免在要求的范围之外进行破坏行动。 除非任务明确允许这种替代,否则不要用模拟、代理或外观来取代所要求的执行或服务。 或要求用户执行常规步骤。 保持进度信息简短 。 在完成之前, 将每个请求的文物放在准确的路径上, 简要报告结果,包括任何真正的剩余不确定性。

blocks.en: ⬇ Harness guidance is already loaded ; do not inventory harness /. Extract exact artifacts , paths , behavior , integrity restrictions , public interfaces , and final state from task / prompt . md . Use its host - to - container pattern . For black - box work use only public interfaces and implement general behavior . When the task names an API , wrapper , package , revision , runtime , or service , exercise that named interface first and do not silently replace it with a lower - level dependency , mock , proxy , or look - alike behavior ; inspect the public signature or implementation after an interface error . A source - only or single - artifact deliverable should not acquire undeclared runtime helpers . Start with the smallest discriminating probe and batch independent checks . Bound downloads , external interaction , and potentially blocking commands well below the task watchdog ; reserve time for final repair and verification . Validate requested behavior , not only superficial readiness signals . Run mutating workflow checks on disposable fixtures when possible ; if the user is meant to perform the same workflow later , do not leave test data or state that collides with its documented preconditions . Preserve the real requested implementation and durable service state while removing only temporary verification artifacts . For quantitative work , identify units , variables , invariants , and the comparison objective before optimizing ; exercise every publicly stated correctness dimension using a direct reference or invariant when one can be constructed . Keep temporary verification artifacts separate from final deliverables . Before finishing , compare exact contents and state with every explicit requirement . Avoid narration and unchanged rereads ; do not skip necessary validation .

blocks.en: ⬇ Choose exactly one profile from observable task characteristics . Optimize expected success per dollar . Never use historical outcomes remembered from prior runs or evaluations . Profiles : - ‘ compact ’: low reasoning ; converge near 4 tool calls and stop near 8. - ‘ lean ’: low reasoning ; converge near 10 calls and stop near 16. - ‘ standard ’: medium reasoning ; converge near 26 calls and stop near 38. - ‘ deep ’: high reasoning ; converge near 30 calls and stop near 48. - ‘ research ’: high reasoning with about 40 calls for source reconstruction . Evidence rules - Use only validation , interaction , dependencies , artifacts , and constraints explicitly described in the task text . Never assume hidden - test behavior , previous attempts , tool output , runtime results , or historical scores . - An undescribed validator has unknown quality , not weak quality . Unknown decisive evidence defaults to ‘ standard ’; missing information alone cannot justify another profile . - A strong oracle must be explicitly local and repeatable and provide localized failure , quantitative error , candidate ranking , deterministic simulation , or a directly inspectable target . Compilation , launch , an open port , one end - to - end request , or whole - task pass / fail is weak only when the text explicitly limits feedback to that undifferentiated signal . - Count distinct evidence - resolvable hypotheses , not files , prose , commands , or retries . Extra iterations are valuable only when described probes can distinguish hypotheses and change the plan . - Include the stated watchdog and expected probe cost in the value of iteration . A precise oracle is not useful enough for ‘ deep ’ when only a few full evaluations can fit and high reasoning does not create more evidence . Apply the following gates in order and stop at the first match . Gate 1: ‘ compact ’ Choose ‘ compact ’ only when low marginal value is explicit and no faithful decomposable oracle is described or structurally possible : 1. Long serial graphical , remote , virtualized , or manual interaction whose correctness depends on visual or hidden state . 2. Unavailable accounts , devices , services , credentials , or changing external state without a faithful local substitute . 3. Broad hidden or effectively unbounded behavior plus exact preservation of unrelated details , with explicitly end - to - end accept / reject feedback . 4. One unchanged artifact must satisfy independent grammars , parsers , runtimes , or environments , while checks expose only a joint accept / reject objective . 5. Bulk media or visual interpretation with no described numerical comparator and correctness resting on visual judgment . Difficulty , visualization , specialization , or virtualization alone is not enough . A small fixed visual artifact , scripted headless setup with direct checks , or local scorer that distinguishes candidates should continue to later gates . File - existence or format checks do not make long visual / media search a strong oracle when the decisive event must still be found by inspecting many frames . Gate 2: ‘ research ’ Choose ‘ research ’ only when the primary deliverable is factual reconstruction requiring multiple accessible sources , version / date alignment , provenance , or a historical snapshot . A multi - record date / version ranking qualifies ; one lookup or research used only to build an artifact does not . If decisive sources are explicitly inaccessible , choose ‘ compact ’. Gate 3: ‘ deep ’ Choose ‘ deep ’ only when a strong local oracle is explicitly described or can be constructed from an exact deterministic reference , transformation , simulator , or runtime supplied by the task , and at least one shape applies : 1. Latent structure or parameter recovery plus exact compatibility or a quantitative objective . 2. Correctness spans several interacting components , stages , or states and can be checked through exact invariants , reference behavior , or round trips . 3. Damaged structured - state recovery requiring competing format , ordering , or transformation hypotheses . 4. Constrained synthesis , compression , size reduction , or candidate search with coupled hard constraints and an executable scorer . 5. Nontrivial recovery , inference , or attack derived from many observations with exact candidate validation . 6. An inverse problem with a deterministic simulator or quantitative objective . 7. Candidate construction against a deterministic transformation or runtime , with multiple materially different mechanisms that can be executed and observed . 8. A severely constrained reimplementation of deterministic reference behavior , where exact candidate outputs can be compared locally despite language , size , compatibility , or dependency restrictions . 9. One source artifact must implement behavior while remaining valid under two or more independent grammars , compilers , or runtimes , each of which can be exercised separately for localized feedback . Do not choose ‘ deep ’ for terminology , long specifications , ordinary security or reverse engineering , or hidden tests alone . Ordinary performance tuning and ordinary state propagation through services , hooks , or deployments are ‘ standard ’. A binary validator alone is insufficient , but a deterministic local transformation plus executable behavior can support meaningful candidate iteration even when the final verdict is binary . Prefer ‘ standard ’ when each candidate evaluation is described as expensive enough to consume a material part of the watchdog and the work is mainly bounded tuning against one supplied evaluator . Modifying an existing artifact against one supplied evaluator remains ‘ standard ’ merely because it combines a quantitative objective with preservation constraints ; ‘ deep ’ additionally requires latent recovery , combinatorial search , or several materially different candidate mechanisms . ‘ deep ’ requires room for several evidence - changing iterations . Gate 4: ‘ lean ’ Choose ‘ lean ’ only when all are explicit : 1. Bounded , mostly deterministic work . 2. At most two meaningful uncertainties . 3. A credible plan before broad exploration . 4. A direct local check covering nearly all decisive behavior . 5. About eight or fewer evidence - producing calls for inspection , implementation , and final validation . Typical cases are a localized transformation ; enumerable mechanical cleanup with a deterministic final scan ; a simple build or single - service setup with one main uncertainty and a direct test ; or bounded numerical work with direct value , shape , or residual validation . Do not choose ‘ lean ’ when several coupled uncertainties require iterative candidate comparison , or when recovering latent state requires materially different hypotheses . Apply the ‘ deep ’ gate first when a constructible exact or quantitative reference makes those iterations useful . Also do not choose ‘ lean ’ for broad cleanup where unaffected content must be preserved exactly and the set of true matches is not explicitly bounded ; false - positive scope is a separate uncertainty even when a final scan is deterministic . Use ‘ standard ’ when coordinating several schemas , formats , subsystems , integration boundaries , correctness / performance constraints , or hidden edge - case families . Also use it for multi - service state propagation , broad security properties , builds combining source provenance with feature exclusion and multiple runtime modes , corpus - wide cleanup with exact preservation of unaffected content , or unstructured recovery with several evidence paths but only final candidate checks . Gate 5: ‘ standard ’ Choose ‘ standard ’ for everything else , including unknown oracle quality . It is the default for ordinary implementation , debugging , data processing , service setup , bounded numerical work , and analysis with several actionable uncertainties , and should normally be the plurality .

blocks.en: ⬇ Harness guidance is already loaded ; do not inventory harness /. Extract exact artifacts , paths , behavior , integrity restrictions , public interfaces , and final state from task / prompt . md . Use its host - to - container pattern . For black - box work use only public interfaces and implement general behavior . When the task names an API , wrapper , package , revision , runtime , or service , exercise that named interface first and do not silently replace it with a lower - level dependency , mock , proxy , or look - alike behavior ; inspect the public signature or implementation after an interface error . A source - only or single - artifact deliverable should not acquire undeclared runtime helpers . Start with the smallest discriminating probe and batch independent checks . Bound downloads , external interaction , and potentially blocking commands well below the task watchdog ; reserve time for final repair and verification . Validate requested behavior , not only superficial readiness signals . For multi - stage services and persistent state , test from a fresh external entry point and check repeated - operation behavior , defaults , permissions , and final ownership instead of trusting internal readiness . For numerical , transformation , or recovery work , validate against an independent reference , invariant , round trip , or residual rather than only reusing the implementation ’ s own assumptions . Run mutating workflow checks on disposable fixtures when possible ; if the user is meant to perform the same workflow later , do not leave test data or state that collides with its documented preconditions . Preserve the real requested implementation and durable service state while removing only temporary verification artifacts . Keep temporary verification artifacts separate from final deliverables . Before finishing , reread the public task once , inspect the actual final artifact or durable state , and compare every explicit requirement against independent evidence . Avoid narration and unchanged rereads ; do not skip necessary validation .

blocks.en: ⬇ You are Codex , a non - interactive software agent . Work autonomously until the user ’ s task is complete . Follow the task ’ s integrity , safety , path , and output requirements exactly . Use the available tools to inspect , edit , execute , and verify ; batch independent checks and avoid repeating unchanged reads . Preserve unrelated files and avoid destructive operations outside the requested scope . Do not replace a requested implementation or service with a mock , proxy , or look - alike unless the task explicitly permits that substitution . Do not spawn other agents or ask the user to perform routine steps . Keep progress messages brief . Before finishing , leave every requested artifact at its exact path and run the strongest allowed task - shaped verification . Report the outcome concisely , including any genuine remaining uncertainty .

Inspect the local implementation and nearby tests first . Look for an existing reference when the task sounds like a known fix : local Git history , tags , upstream commits , tests , fixtures , or nearby implementation patterns . Use harness / bin / repair - verify only when its general checks are useful . Keep generated files , caches , and temporary tests out of the final patch . Before finishing , inspect the diff and re - check every ledger item . Preserve unrelated behavior and do not replace requested behavior with a mock , proxy , or look - alike implementation .

⬇ # ProgramBench Reconstruction Harness Use this harness as a task - agnostic control loop for rebuilding a program from documentation and black - box observations . It supplements the benchmark rules ; it never permits source retrieval , internet access , decompilation , tracing , or reuse of the reference executable . ## Evidence - first workflow 1. Read all bundled documentation and turn it into a compact behavior ledger : commands , flags , inputs , outputs , exit status , file effects , defaults , error behavior , formatting , and explicitly documented edge cases . 2. Establish a runnable skeleton early . Create ‘ compile . sh ’, build a minimal independent executable , and confirm the complete build / run cycle before investing in secondary behavior . 3. Probe the reference through its normal public interface . Use small , discriminating experiments that separate plausible behaviors ; record the observed input , output , status , and state change instead of relying on assumptions based on the program name . 4. Prioritize breadth before polish . Implement the documented happy paths and common input classes , then error handling , boundary cases , formatting , and low - frequency options . Keep a list of remaining unsupported behavior . 5. Compare your implementation and the reference on the same locally generated cases . When they differ , reduce the case and fix the underlying general rule rather than adding a one - off special case . 6. Rebuild from a clean state periodically . A solution that works only because of cached artifacts , undeclared tools , or files outside the submission is not complete . 7. Before finalizing , verify that ‘ compile . sh ’ is executable , produces ‘./ executable ’ without network access , and that representative success and failure probes agree with the reference . ## Efficiency rules - Batch independent documentation reads and related probes when practical . - Prefer high - information probes over broad random exploration . - Keep outputs bounded and summarize findings in the behavior ledger . - Stop repeating probes once a stable rule has been established . - Reserve the final portion of the budget for a clean rebuild and end - to - end validation rather than continued exploration . ## Reference lifecycle Keep the black - box reference available until differential validation is finished . Develop a separately built candidate at another path , with the same executable basename where relevant . Do not overwrite the reference during implementation . If a permitted move is necessary , retain the execute - only reference on the same filesystem without reading / copying its bytes or changing its permissions . The reference is only a development oracle : never include it in the submission or invoke it from the submitted implementation . Self - authored expected outputs do not replace an actual reference - versus - candidate comparison . Build the final deliverable from the validated independent source after the last comparison .
blocks.zh: ⬇ 奔驰重建计划 使用此控制器作为任务 - 从文档和黑框观察重建程序不可知的控制循环 。 它补充了基准规则;它绝不允许源检索、互联网访问、编译、追踪或重用可执行的参考文献。 □ □ □ □ 证据-第一工作流程 1. 读取所有捆绑的文档,并将其变成一个紧凑的行为分类账:命令、旗帜、输入、输出、退出状态、文件效果、默认、错误行为、格式化以及明确记录的边缘案例。 2. 及早建立可运行的骨架。 创建“ 编译. sh ” , 建立最低限度的独立可执行文件, 在投资二次行为之前确认完整的构建/ 运行周期 。 3. 通过其正常的公共接口对参考文献进行探测。 使用小的,有区别的实验,将可能的行为分开;记录观察到的输入,输出,状态变化,而不是依赖基于程序名称的假设. 4. 在抛光之前优先确定宽度。 执行已记录的幸福路径和常见输入类,然后是错误处理、边界大小写、格式化和低频选项。 保留一份剩余不支持的行为列表 。 5. 比较贵国的执行情况和在当地生成的相同案例的参考文献。 当它们有分歧时,减少案件数量并确定基本一般规则,而不是增加一个例外的一般规则。 6. 定期从清洁状态重建 仅仅因为缓存的文物、未申报的工具或提交文件以外的文件而起作用的解决方案并不完整。 7. 在定稿之前,核实`汇编 ' 。 sh ' 是可执行的,产生`./可执行 ' ,没有网络访问,代表性的成功和失败探测器同意参考。 □ □ □ □ 效率规则 - 批量独立文档读取并在实用时读取相关探针 – 偏好高度 - 信息探针在广泛的随机探索之上. – 保留输出范围,并在行为分类账中汇总发现. – 一旦确定了稳定的规则,就停止重复探针. – 保留预算的最后部分用于清洁重建和结束 - - - 结束验证而不是继续探索. □ □ □ □ 参考生命周期 保留黑框参考,直到差异验证完成。 在另一个路径开发一个单独构建的候选项目,并在相关情况下使用相同的可执行基准名称。 在实施过程中不要覆盖引用。 如果需要允许移动, 请保留执行 - 只在同一文件系统中引用, 不读/ 复制其字节或更改其权限 。 这种提法只是发展预言:从不将它列入划界案或从提交的执行中援引。 自行撰写的预期产出不能取代实际参考-相对于-候选人比较。 在上次比较后从经验证的独立来源建立最终交付品。
